entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Warding Light

*A warm light settles over one companion like a hand on the shoulder.*

One willing ally within 3 squares reduces Frightened by 1. Until this creature’s next turn, that ally also has 1 Boon on its next defense against a mental attack; for an NPC ally, impose 1 Bane on that player attack. Consumed even if canceled; does not stack with itself.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Used bandages hang beside a small field shrine.

**Purpose:** Keep the people under their care alive.

**Tactics and retreat:** Heal an ally before trading staff blows; withdraw with wounded companions when life costs become dangerous.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Pressure the healer’s position, separate them from patients, or negotiate safe evacuation.

**Habitat:** Camp; temple · **Communication:** Common

**Loot:** Staff, shrine token and 12 coins.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-battle-chaplain


**Category:** Mortal · **Role:** Healer · **CV:** 13

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Staff | Brawn | None | 2 physical damage. | 3 physical damage. | 5 physical damage. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 2/3/5

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.55

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.5 → 1.55: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=5.000, O=2.162. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [battle mending](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/battle-mending.md), [Warding Light](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/warding-light.md).

monsterAbilityTemplates.rulesMarkdown:
One visible adjacent living creature; free hand required. Pay the printed life cost first, bypassing resistance, and remain above 0 HP. A player controller rolls the creature’s printed healing attribute for its printed HP outcomes. For a hostile NPC healing an ally, ask a player to make that same creature-attribute roll, including its applicable Boons/Banes. The DA still chooses its action and target; being the dice roller grants no control of the NPC. Life resistance reduces healing normally. This may instead target a healing-harmed creature: the result becomes Life damage, with Fortitude defense if a player is defending for that creature and no extra opposed roll. Keep the same range, life cost and free-hand requirement. This can be repeated while affordable. Provokes as spellcasting; no separate spell slots.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

*Light travels from the healer’s shaking hands into another body, leaving the healer visibly diminished.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-battle-mending


**Action:** Main Action; spell

This may instead target a healing-harmed creature: the result becomes Life damage, with Fortitude defense if a player is defending for that creature and no extra opposed roll. Keep the same range, life cost and free-hand requirement. This can be repeated while affordable. Provokes as spellcasting; no separate spell slots.
